create.name: Lynne Goldberg
create.bio:
Lynne Goldberg is a meditation teacher and author whose work centres on sitting still with life as it actually is, especially when plans fall apart. She turned to meditation during a hard family time and kept returning to it through the long and uneven road of becoming a mother. Her teaching began in schools, and when teachers asked for something to use at home, the idea grew into Breethe, the meditation app she co-founded and where she built up the first library of guided sessions and became its public face.

Her style is plain, warm and often funny, aimed at busy people who doubt they can meditate at all. She now teaches what she calls Choicefulness: noticing a reaction, pausing, and deciding how to meet what comes next, taught through short guided practices, journal prompts and five stages she names Radical Recognition, Feel the Feels, Adapt, Alchemize and Rise. Her book Catching Your Breath, a meditative guide to starting over in midlife with a foreword by Chip Conley, is due from BenBella Books in January 2027. She also speaks at conferences and companies, and offers a short free guided meditation to anyone who joins her mailing list.

books.title: Catching Your Breath: A Meditative Guide to Midlife Soul-Shifting
books.author: Lynne Goldberg
books.description: A frank, often humorous account of rebuilding a life in middle age after the ground shifts, from the end of a long marriage to children leaving home. Each chapter pairs her own story with reflection prompts and short mindfulness practices for people new to meditation. Due 19 January 2027.

free_resources.title: Five Minutes of Peace
free_resources.description: A short guided meditation sent free by email when you join her mailing list. It is a simple pause to settle the breath and attention, suitable for complete beginners.

sprint.tier_evidence: Instagram @lynnegoldbergmeditation 360K followers (og:description, 31 Oct 2026); no personal YouTube, Facebook, X or TikTok found (LinkedIn not counted) → ~360k total → luminary
flags: Her only Omega offering, '7 Steps to Healing Your Heart' (on-demand, member $35 USD), was left out as borderline: it is about forgiveness and grudges, not a condition, but its pages talk of healing 'emotional pain'. A human may want to add it back (https://www.eomega.org/workshops/7-steps-healing-your-heart).
No paid offering of her own is open: the Soul Shift Method is 'coming soon' and Work With Me is speaking/corporate only. Page has 5 videos, 1 book (pre-order) and 1 free meditation.
Partly a speaker and app co-founder; teaching is secular mindfulness and meditation rather than a spiritual tradition.
The book is a pre-order (out 19 Jan 2027); ASIN B0H58K1Q8J is the one her site links to and its amazon.com page loads (ISBN 9798902680345).
Free meditation is gated behind a mailing-list sign-up; the URL is the sign-up section of her home page.
Breethe channel videos voiced by unnamed narrators were not used; only ones that name her.
left_out: 7 Steps to Healing Your Heart (Omega on-demand course): borderline 'healing / emotional pain' framing.
Breethe app: company product, not her own offering.
Get Balanced, Get Blissed (Balboa Press): not confirmed to be her or on amazon.com.
Journal posts on sleep and grief: articles, and condition-adjacent.
